summary: Official Gambia Ministry of Lands / Department of Lands and Survey custodians were identified. Official policy and an official oversight report discuss cadastral maps and land-information reform, including the West Coast Region, but the current public ministry site exposes no parcel viewer or anonymous parcel API. No safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.
queryAndRequestOutcome: Two discovery queries were executed and recorded in city-206-brikama.json: one English query and one native/local-language discovery slot using the exact existing query text. The evidence notes that English is The Gambia's official/administrative language and no separate public registry language or translated public interface was exposed; no query text or result URL was invented. Current ministry HTML/assets, official WordPress search routes, and government directory pages were fetched over normal TLS.
custodian: National custodian: Ministry of Lands and Regional Government, through the Department of Lands and Survey. Local context: Brikama Area Council. No local Brikama parcel service was evidenced.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [13.2737769054355, -16.6451648906323] and population 184321 persons are preserved.
No public parcel endpoint was found, so no exact-point query, map extent test, schema inspection, CRS observation, or parcel geometry qualification was possible.
The absence of a public endpoint is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No source-specific raw attribute set or unsafe personal/property-rights fields were retained.
Completion is research-packet completion only, not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: Brikama/West Coast cadastral maps may exist offline or behind a non-indexed official workflow.
Native parcel IDs, geometry, CRS, public query semantics, and citywide coverage remain unverified.
